provenance.sourceAccessMethod: Retained final HTML parsed in full to readable text, sources.md read through all 776 lines, all three research appendices, model/calculations and final verification/arithmetic records read locally. No external research or refresh. UK manifest inspected for UTC/local dating.
provenance.originalResearchAccessLimitations: Original research was public and unauthenticated. Early automatic browser-readability fallbacks did not expose session identities, so a clean session cannot be certified for those fallbacks. Crucial school sources were subsequently captured by unauthenticated HTTP. Controlled CBN/layout checks used fresh empty contexts. No login, personal credential import, form submission or school contact was intentionally performed. McMaster's linked fee schedule required sign-in and was not accessed.
provenance.publicationDates: Unknown except explicit price-year, award-cycle, document, policy and survey-cohort labels retained in prose. Access dates are not publication dates.

datePolicy: Every cited URL is individually assigned the retained local research/access date 2026-11-07 from the source register and appendices. UK capture manifest records 2026-11-06 UTC, corresponding to 2026-11-07 Asia/Singapore. FX observations are dated 2026-11-06, not the access date. Authoring is not an external source refresh; undated source publication dates, original model and publication date remain unknown.
uncertainties: Specific Nigerian/Lagos applicant; degree classification/equivalence, management responsibilities, experience chronology, English evidence and employer recognition are not established by age or six years of work.

Online budgets are incremental education cash, not Lagos household totals. Preserving US$5,000 leaves no-award gaps of US$11,377.50 for BU and US$12,315.80 for Gies; monthly funding is 55–59% of current gross earnings before tax and living.

UK tuition is published for 2027; DeGroote 2027/2028 tuition is approximate. Gies 2026/27 and BU Fall 2026 prices do not lock a future multi-year total. Gies US$90 application row is an unconfirmed allowance, not a sourced tariff.

All nonofficial line items are planning allowances with a 10% contingency. No overseas work/internship earnings, scholarships or loan approvals assumed; no post-graduation job-search costs, optional trips, dependants, FX spreads or payment taxes/charges included. Personal reserve is separate. Tuition-credit deposits and proof funds are not double-counted.
UK living guides do not establish a full 2027 year; Birmingham's 42-week guide has an inconsistent catered total. Sheffield examples are 2026/27 rent only. IHS depends on actual permission dates.

Canada ancillary/insurance assessment is unconfirmed and C$6,000 is not a cap. UHIP is 2026/27 only; MBA supplementary cover is separate. Standard DeGroote route is 20 months, not co-op or 24 months; actual 2027 teaching location must be confirmed before housing.

Awards are conditional, tuition-focused and not assumed to stack. Sheffield excludes exceptions entrants and requires self-funding; Birmingham funding days unknown. DeGroote FAQ lower bound differs from newer finance page; competition value is from 2025, 2027 terms unconfirmed; Forté gender/amount unconfirmed. Gies–Coursera Nigerian eligibility and exact autumn 2027 funding/applications remain unconfirmed; BU offers no institutional Online MBA scholarship.

Birmingham international deadline can close early; Sheffield visa date is university-wide. DeGroote final international is March 14, 2027, not May 31. January online standard deadlines and Gies Spring scholarship-priority date have passed as of the retained reference day.

Optional GMAT/GRE is not the same as DeGroote's discretionary grade-based waiver. English admissions waivers are personal and do not waive PGWP language evidence. Online live sessions/team assignments may conflict with bank work; longer completion adds costs.

No Nigeria-specific salary ROI or job probability established. UK cohort employment/median evidence unavailable; DeGroote salary coverage is limited and mixes no 2025 finance salary cohort; BU salary lacks mean/median and sample details; Gies survey dates/sample unavailable. Career services differ from residential placement and AACSB does not guarantee employer recognition.

No lender quote; hard-currency loan stress assumes 12% APR and 10 years, excludes fees/capitalised study interest. Dated official FX references are not execution quotes; USD holdings do not remove GBP/CAD cross-rate risk. Forgone gross earnings are separate opportunity costs, not added cash charges.

Immigration is dated general information, not legal/immigration advice. UK 18-month Graduate and potential Canada three-year PGWP require all personal/course conditions; neither guarantees work or residence. Online US study from Lagos creates neither UK Graduate nor Canadian PGWP eligibility. Maintenance floors and fees require future rechecking.
